suite: Full relevant test suite = repository ctest collection (75 ONNX operator tests, tests/op/test_onnx_op_*.cpp, CPU reference backend) + CUDA-backend on-GPU parity harness (9 ImageNet-style models). This file is a completeness-correction re-run: the previous record ran ONLY the 9-model CUDA demo and reported 9/9 as the whole suite.
run_command: (cd build && ctest --output-on-failure -V --timeout 120)  # 75 registered onnx op tests, CPU reference backend  ;  bash corex_port/test/run_tests.sh  # 9-model CUDA-vs-CPU top-5 parity on GPU 1
scope_note: Only PART B (9 models via tm_classification_cuda) exercises the migrated CUDA backend. PART A (all 75 ctest onnx op tests) runs on the Tengine CPU reference backend via create_graph(nullptr,...) and does NOT touch CUDA; the test binaries hardcode the default (CPU) context so there is no env/flag to point them at the CUDA backend without source edits. All 75 fail at model-load ('cannot open file ../onnx_node/<op>/onnx.tmfile') because the required per-op ONNX node model/tensor data cannot be produced or located here (verified via Failure-Gate probe, see test.log PROBE + below). They never reach inference, so this is not a CoreX/CUDA defect; counted as legitimate skips and out of CUDA migration scope.
raw_ctest_result: ctest exit=8: 75/75 Failed, 100% with 'cannot open file ../onnx_node/<op>/onnx.tmfile -> Create graph failed' (missing external test data at load time; no inference reached). Full verbose output is in test.log PART A. Reclassified here as skipped(legitimate), NOT passed.

skipped_reasons.reason: cannot open file ../onnx_node/<op>/onnx.tmfile — required per-op ONNX node model/tensor data cannot be produced or located: onnx python pkg NOT importable by any system interpreter (only onnxruntime-gpu is installed, which ships neither the ONNX node conformance data backend/test/data/node/* nor the onnx.helper authoring API, and itself fails to import: libtvm.so missing); no onnx_node/model.onnx node data exists anywhere on host; onnx must not be installed/built/vendored per instruction.
skipped_reasons.note: 跟进复核(v2)：用户称 onnx 已系统安装，但经 Failure-Gate 实测证伪——任何系统解释器 `import onnx` 均失败(`from onnx import helper` ImportError)，全机唯一 onnx 家族包是 onnxruntime-gpu(且因缺 libtvm.so 无法加载)，它既不含 ONNX 节点一致性测试数据(backend/test/data/node/test_*)，也不含用于构建模型的 onnx.helper API；全盘 find 未见任何 onnx_node 目录或节点级 model.onnx(仅有 Tengine 自带 mnist.onnx 与 onnxruntime 的 3 个 demo 模型，均非本测试所需)。因此这 75 个 ctest ONNX 算子测试所需的 ../onnx_node/<op>/{onnx.tmfile,test_data_set_0/*.pb} 无法生成或定位(且禁止安装/vendor onnx)。它们全部跑在 CPU 参考后端(create_graph(nullptr,...))、不经过 CUDA、属迁移范围外，且在加载模型阶段即失败、从未进入推理——非 CoreX/CUDA 缺陷。原始 ctest 判定 75 Failed(退出码 8，同一 cannot-open-file 原因)已完整保留在 test.log PART A；此处如实归类为 legitimate 跳过，未计为通过。证据见 test.log PROBE 段。75 个测试二进制均已用 CoreX clang++ 编译通过。
